messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Unity Maju Makanan Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Kelantan (Food & Beverage).", "The register lists 5 directors. Director 4 holds the largest disclosed stake (38%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 6,263,314 and the after-tax profit was RM 195,075.", "No court cases appear in the supplied record."], "menu": {"audit": {"fact": "The FY2022 audit opinion was “Disclaimer of opinion”. The FY2024 audit opinion was “Unqualified”.", "next_check": "Read the auditor’s report and management’s response to the earlier findings."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 632,801.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 4,142,772.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax profit of RM 228,256.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 1.31×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 3.1%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 2017-09-26.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue rose 3.3% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
